outcome: Serum levels of Th-1 cytokines (CCL2, CCL4, IFN-g, CCL11, TNF-a)
Placental expression of chemokines scavenger decoy D6 receptor (D6 expression)
cohort: The study included singleton pregnancies with gestational diabetes mellitus (n=25 for serum, n=10 for placenta) and gestational age-matched normal pregnant women (n=25 for serum, n=7 for placenta).
finding: GDM is characterized by higher serum levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines (CCL-2, CCL-4, IFN-g) and consistent over-expression of the inflammasome NLRP-3 in placental tissues compared to normal pregnancy.
cross-section timing: Serum samples were collected between 24 and 28 weeks of pregnancy, and placental samples were analyzed (timing of collection not explicitly stated but implied at birth).
gest_age: 24 and 28 weeks of pregnancy (for serum sample collection), with gestational age-matched controls.
